title: Tales of Eldevia
tagline: Discover the secrets of the metaverse through specific missions for each class, unravel the mysteries, defeat enemies and shape the story with your choices.  Evolve your character, making him UNIQUE and inimitable, in a continuous struggle between good and evil.
description:
Fantasy-style Dungeon Crawler to face in Singleplayer.

Discover the secrets of the metaverse through specific missions for each class, unravel the mysteries, defeat enemies and shape the story with your choices.

Evolve your character, making him UNIQUE and inimitable, in a continuous struggle between good and evil.

---

Details.

The heroes of the game are NFTs on the Polygon network. They can be minted for free to play the initial five levels, after which players can upgrade, including hero customization, choice of archetypes, and skills.

An ERC-20 token will be implemented to manage the game's economy.

---

Unique selling point.

Five races of heroes will be released initially, with the option to mint the starter character for free. Upon passing the first five levels of the game, based on the choices made, you will be able to mint an essence that will either prune you on the path of blessing or corrupt your soul and take you on the path of darkness.

The ability to determine your hero's fate through game actions and original graphics make this blockchain game one of a kind.

---

Analysis.

Dungeon Crawlers in the web2 context limit users' ability to own items accumulated in the game. With the advent of the blockchain, the end-user has the opportunity to participate in the growth of the ecosystem, creating interests (financial and otherwise) that can give rise to entirely new scenarios.

In this context, all the community participants can contribute positively to the improvement of the ecosystem; not only the core team and investors but also Dungeon Masters and independent developers can create new and exciting quests, adventures, or clashes.
